sys_script_include.description:
This is a Generative AI Skill Search outputs (results) processor. It filters skills based on a confidence policy (sys_property "com.glide.one.extend.capability.genai.skill.search.confidence.policy" -- the allowed values are MATCHING or SOMEWHAT_MATCHING). It marks up the outputs result with "skills" and "unfiltered_skills".
MATCHING means only accept skills returned from the provider-specific skill search that match a provider-specific criteria (e.g., if a provider score is > .8 then it matches).
SOMEWHAT_MATCHING mean accept all skills returned from the provider-specific skill search.
sys_script_include.name: GenAISkillSearchOutputsProcessor
